title: 1D Confined Aquifer Constant-Head Flow
description: Steady-state MODFLOW 6 single-layer confined sandstone aquifer with constant-head upstream and downstream boundaries demonstrating Darcy linear hydraulic gradient.
code:
# 1D Confined Aquifer Discretization (1 layer x 1 row x 10 columns)
BEGIN DIS6
  NLAY 1
  NROW 1
  NCOL 10
  DELR 100.0
  DELC 100.0
  TOP 50.0
  BOTM 20.0
END DIS6

files.gwf.dis:
# 1D Confined Aquifer Discretization (1 layer x 1 row x 10 columns)
BEGIN DIS6
  NLAY 1
  NROW 1
  NCOL 10
  DELR 100.0
  DELC 100.0
  TOP 50.0
  BOTM 20.0
END DIS6
files.gwf.chd:
# Constant-Head Boundary Conditions (West 50m -> East 40m)
BEGIN CHD6
  1 1 1 50.0
  1 1 10 40.0
END CHD6
files.gwf.ic:
# Initial Conditions Package
BEGIN GRIDDATA
  STRT
    CONSTANT 48.0
END GRIDDATA
files.gwf.nam:
# MODFLOW 6 GWF Model Name File
BEGIN OPTIONS
  SAVE_FLOWS
END OPTIONS

BEGIN PACKAGES
  DIS6 gwf.dis
  NPF6 gwf.npf
  IC6  gwf.ic
  CHD6 gwf.chd
END PACKAGES
files.gwf.npf:
# Node Property Flow Package (Homogeneous Confined Sandstone)
BEGIN NPF6
  K 12.0
  K33 1.2
  SS 1.0e-5
  SY 0.18
END NPF6
files.mfsim.nam:
# MODFLOW 6 Simulation Name File
BEGIN OPTIONS
END OPTIONS

BEGIN MODELS
  GWF6 gwf.nam gwf_confined
END MODELS

title: Two-Layer Aquifer-Aquitard Vertical Leakage
description: MODFLOW 6 two-layer hydrogeologic system modeling vertical leakage from an unconfined water-table aquifer receiving areal recharge into a deeper pumped confined sandstone layer.
code:

BEGIN DIS6
  NLAY 2
  NROW 8
  NCOL 8
  DELR 150.0
  DELC 150.0

  BOTM 45.0 10.0
END DIS6

title: Regional 3-Layer Coastal Wellfield Transient Dewatering
description: Full 11-file MODFLOW 6 transient coastal aquifer wellfield model spanning three hydrogeologic layers with ocean constant-head boundary, coastal estuary river, multi-well extraction, and output control.
code:
# 3-Layer Coastal Aquifer Discretization (3 layers x 12 rows x 12 columns)
BEGIN DIS6
  NLAY 3
  NROW 12
  NCOL 12
  DELR 250.0
  DELC 250.0
  TOP 40.0
  BOTM 15.0 -15.0 -60.0
END DIS6

files.gwf.dis:
# 3-Layer Coastal Aquifer Discretization (3 layers x 12 rows x 12 columns)
BEGIN DIS6
  NLAY 3
  NROW 12
  NCOL 12
  DELR 250.0
  DELC 250.0
  TOP 40.0
  BOTM 15.0 -15.0 -60.0
END DIS6
files.gwf.chd:
# Upland Recharge Boundary (Col 1) and Mean Sea Level Ocean Boundary (Col 12)
BEGIN CHD6
  1 1 1 28.0
  1 12 1 28.0
  1 1 12 0.0
  1 12 12 0.0
  3 1 12 0.0
  3 12 12 0.0
END CHD6
files.gwf.ic:
# Initial Head Distribution
BEGIN GRIDDATA
  STRT
    CONSTANT 18.0
END GRIDDATA
files.gwf.nam:
# MODFLOW 6 Regional 3-Layer Coastal GWF Name File

  SAVE_FLOWS
END OPTIONS

BEGIN PACKAGES

  RIV6 gwf.riv
  OC6  gwf.oc

files.gwf.npf:
